title: Exclude rank saving for orthogonal fresh-bridge families
body:
**This scoped negative proof excludes paid-rank saving for the prescribed family of orthogonal fresh-coordinate bridges.** It covers any old basis dimension N and any number b of these bridges with `N*b` even, subject to the exact word and relation hypotheses below. This settles the paid-word question for the named two-link alphabet in [PR #7707](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7707) under that relation budget. **No new kappa** follows.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c396e9ee03b331f3b46aa87526817b237f5ad6f8/research/orthogonal-bridge-family-obstruction/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c396e9ee03b331f3b46aa87526817b237f5ad6f8/research/orthogonal-bridge-family-obstruction/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c396e9ee03b331f3b46aa87526817b237f5ad6f8/research/orthogonal-bridge-family-obstruction/verify.py) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c396e9ee03b331f3b46aa87526817b237f5ad6f8/research/orthogonal-bridge-family-obstruction/CREDITS.md).

The old projectors are an arbitrary binary image basis and its dual, including coordinate projectors. Each bridge has old factors equal to their respective sums, its own literal fresh image axis, and a fresh covector given by a row of `Z=I_b+(N modulo 2)J_b`. Require Z invertible, equivalently `N*b` even. Every old and bridge type occurs, with no additional types. Calls are `I+([A_j]-1)P` over the paid-generated torsion-free abelian exponent group. Its saturated relation rank is at most the actual off-pattern dimension `k=N-d+b`, where d is the old diagonal-intersection dimension. The endpoint must be diagonal monomial on the full original ambient space.

No old call lies between the first and last occurrence of any bridge type. The bridge types commute, so they can interleave and then be collected without crossing old calls. Every collected bridge total is zero. Deletion preserves all ambient inputs, and each physical target exponent is a sum of a disjoint subset of old paid exponents. Rank subadditivity gives total target rank at most total paid rank.

The new step handles the star dependences: their rank is Nb for odd N and `Nb-b+1` for even N. Independent bridge-variable sets force the chronology even when those dependences exist. This extends the prior one-bridge method. It does not assume literal adjacency of one bridge type, or infer exact exponent cancellation from parity alone.

The exceptional sixth projector in the (k,nu,n)=(4,0,5) complete pool is excluded. Its pattern couples two bridge totals and changes the first-order equations. Other even maximizers, larger relation budgets, singular fresh pairings and arbitrary fresh embeddings remain outside this theorem. No native provider, physical implementation or complete multiplication invoice is supplied. The selected kappa stays `0.00363005817`, with all five assumptions retained.

With CPython 3.12 and the standard library, run:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/orthogonal-bridge-family-obstruction
```

Both normal and optimized modes print:

```text
PASS_ORTHOGONAL_BRIDGE_FAMILY_OBSTRUCTION
20335 bases; 81002 basis/bridge checks; 55250 full Laurent words; 10148 passing orders
15 larger fixtures; all bridge totals vanish in the stated class.
```

The finite census checks all 20,335 bases through old dimension four and each permitted b through four. Every one of the 55,250 word orders has a degree-two and full original-coordinate Laurent replay; a separate gap count confirms the 10,148 passing orders. Fifteen larger fixtures reach old dimension ten and six bridges, with repeated calls, literal interleavings and unused spectators. Omitted-call, wrong-pairing, added-relation, wrong-ambient-group, nonzero-even-total and sixth-projector controls pass. Twelve singular pairings have explicit common-kernel vectors.

Normal/optimized replay, committed bytes and modes, source history, export and sealed Git-free replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44331381650/job/134896406680) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence. The unbounded conclusion rests on the written proof. Full predecessor suites, selected cold replay, native/physical replay, Lean, Docker, independent human and formal-kernel review were not run. The adapted checker is not an independent source review.

Base: current main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Ali Romman's [PR #7695](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7695), head `996c002d82420141c19797e4e3b699ed88aee330`, supplies the [Boolean partition, augmentation argument and target matching](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/996c002d82420141c19797e4e3b699ed88aee330/research/orthogonal-basis-bridge-obstruction/PROOF.md), and the [adapted primitives](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/996c002d82420141c19797e4e3b699ed88aee330/research/orthogonal-basis-bridge-obstruction/verify.py). The [two-link geometry and pool exception](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57e24923b609d2588b83321f530fa2a1e75ed364/research/edge-matching-even-attainment/PROOF.md) come from [PR #7707](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7707), head `57e24923b609d2588b83321f530fa2a1e75ed364`, and remain prior results.

Credit @CubeJerry for the original chronology and Laurent methods in [PR #6782](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6782), head `685457252b51b9c7932ece363365bdf0b12c9c31`: [word proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/685457252b51b9c7932ece363365bdf0b12c9c31/research/bit-three-relation-core/FIVE-CORE-WORD.md) and [original recurrence](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/685457252b51b9c7932ece363365bdf0b12c9c31/research/bit-three-relation-core/independent_five_word.py). Ali Romman's [PR #7694](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7694), head `96b8b22f5925c4cf4514ed27575f465ebc95e51a`, supplies the [edge-family extension](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/96b8b22f5925c4cf4514ed27575f465ebc95e51a/research/extremal-core-word-obstruction/PROOF.md). The linked credits retain the earlier geometric contributors. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

The [claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19710858) records the two-link starting question and its generalization within this single result. Live source/phrase overlap and the closed delta were checked. Sparse local and unpublished work remain coverage limits. The [open questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c396e9ee03b331f3b46aa87526817b237f5ad6f8/research/orthogonal-bridge-family-obstruction/README.md) retain the exceptional six-projector pool and other specified alphabets or relation budgets.
